body.input: Jane, the knockout stage is here! Eight teams left, best-of-fives, and the dream of lifting that Summoner’s Cup on the fourteenth of November in Brooklyn.
Yes, Paul, and for once the format makes sense: single elimination, no second chances.
And look who made it: Karmine Corp! First French org in the knockouts since two thousand and eleven!
True. They scrapped through play-ins, lost to LYON and Bilibili Gaming, then beat Movistar KOI to squeeze in at three wins, two losses.
And now they face T1 on the sixth of November. The three-time champs! What a story that could be.
Or a very short one. T1 went three and one in Swiss, and Karmine Corp’s only ever beaten them in our dreams.
But LYON! First Worlds playoffs ever, and they open against Gen.G on the fourth of November!
LYON did beat Karmine Corp in Swiss, but Gen.G went three and zero. That’s a mountain to climb.
Still, five million dollars on the line, one million for the winner. This is why we watch!
And the quarterfinals start on the third of November in Allen, Texas. Let’s see who survives.
I’m calling Karmine Corp to shock the world. Just a feeling.
And I’m calling that feeling delusional. We’ll see on the sixth.
Until then, keep the dream alive, everyone!
